scope: Osborn source qualification and rule dependencies; no parcel-specific regulatory determination.
review_method: Manual visual inspection of PDF pages and enlarged map notes; reading of publisher HTML, service metadata and statute. No PDF tracing or rule-generated zoning geometry.

observations: Signed certification block; initial adoption 2005-08-03 and effectiveness 2005-08-18. Latest printed amendment 2024-08-01 (ZP796) is a clerical FEMA map-adoption text correction.
Map explicitly omits some P-WL waterbody/stream-associated wetlands and P-SL2 along streams through wetlands; water-based boundaries depend on ground locations.
Flood note adopts Hancock County FIS dated 2016-07-20 and accompanying FIRM by reference; special flood hazard areas apply as P-FP even when absent from this drawing.
documents.verification_scope: VERIFIED publication contents, not current legal status or parcel applicability.

observations: Cover and publisher index identify latest revision 2026-04-06. Section 10.04 identifies official maps and amendments as zoning records; 10.05 directs uncertain boundaries to statute and Commission interpretation.
10.23,C,2 incorporates FEMA flood areas and says FEMA boundaries also apply where Commission-mapped boundaries differ.
10.23,L,2 describes P-SL1/P-SL2 using horizontal distance from relevant watermarks/wetland edges and waterbody characteristics. A generic stream-centerline buffer is insufficient.

10.23,N,2 includes waterbodies and qualifying wetlands; Commission evaluation uses NWI and, when required, site delineation. Small mapped inclusions and development-subdistrict exceptions prevent treating an inventory as a complete legal classification.
documents.verification_scope: VERIFIED contents of selected published sections; no complete rule/amendment or permitting review.

publication_observations.observation: Publisher warns that digital data can lag official maps and directs map comparison. The displayed town Update Date is populated from last_edited_date_text, not EFFECTIVE_DATE. No verified legal-current query predicate is supplied here.
Statute addresses water-based boundaries and assigns ground/map discrepancies or other uncertainty to Commission interpretation.
PUBLISH and DRAW domains enumerate Yes/No; captured metadata supplies no legal-current interpretation of these values or END_DATE.
Publisher-linked hosted download endpoint returned HTTP 200 with application error 499 Token Required. This is failed public data access, not an empty zoning dataset. No bypass attempted.

dependencies.required_evidence: LUPC confirmation of current official Osborn map and all effective amendments, plus documented meaning of GIS flags/dates and current selection rule.
dependencies.downstream_rule: Keep legal currency UNKNOWN; retain every captured feature and all dates. Do not substitute service update time for legal effective date.

dependencies.required_evidence: Authoritative Hancock County FIS/FIRM panels covering Osborn, applicable amendments/revisions and reconciliation to LUPC adoption.
dependencies.downstream_rule: No P-FP polygon or no intersection does not establish absence of flood protections. Qualify FEMA evidence before computing an additional screening overlay.

dependencies.required_evidence: Qualified wetland/hydrography inputs with scale, vintage and coverage; site delineation or Commission interpretation where needed.
dependencies.downstream_rule: Retain omitted-protection unknowns; NWI absence does not clear wetlands, and an inventory is not a legal P-WL assignment.

dependencies.required_evidence: Relevant watermarks, wetland edges, drainage and waterbody attributes, boundary confidence and Commission interpretation where uncertain.
dependencies.downstream_rule: Do not create authoritative buffers from approximate centerlines or treat mapped coverage as regulatory completeness.

dependencies.required_evidence: Publisher clarification of accessible download route and redistribution terms.
dependencies.downstream_rule: Keep exact third-party responses private; free availability alone does not establish a redistribution license.

finding_review.next_action: Obtain LUPC confirmation of current Osborn map/amendments and GIS flag/date semantics; qualify adopted FEMA panels/revisions, then wetlands/hydrography evidence. Resolve site boundary dependencies before legal zoning use.
finding_review.note: Documented publication/date semantics and rule-based omissions with exact sources. Published and offline Osborn attributes reconcile by GlobalID, but legal-current selection, full amendment history, omitted-protection extent and redistribution rights remain UNKNOWN. No geometry or screening changes; do not close this finding.
